# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 16 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 16:4 — holy virgin vs. pure virgin

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a pure virgin" | Literal hagnē parthenos |
| LOGOS | "a holy virgin" | Hagnos can mean holy/pure/chaste |
| PNEUMA | "a holy virgin" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** The Greek hagnē can mean both pure and holy. In context, 'holy' (LOGOS/PNEUMA) carries the stronger connotation appropriate to the religious setting. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 16:7 — Joseph knew Aseneth — marital intimacy

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Joseph knew Aseneth" | Literal egnō — standard biblical idiom |
| LOGOS | "Joseph knew Aseneth" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Joseph was with Aseneth" | Softens the biblical idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree on the biblical idiom 'knew.' This is standard biblical language for marital union. PNEUMA's 'was with' is unnecessarily evasive. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
